neighbours.label: quantified plural or distributive reference (every piece, these examples, some states, several of these, each animal), as opposed to definite single things
fire: The guide adds a note on every song.
I've kept these samples since they suit many cases.
Some counties have raised their own sales taxes.
Testing is unfinished for several of these.
Your son will count the wheels on each truck.
Most of these have been sold by now.
Many schools have changed their own rules.
All of those were written by hand.
quiet: The guide is on the shelf.
I've eaten and I'm off to bed.
The county is north of the river.
Testing is done for the car.
Your son is in the garden with the dog.
The house has been sold by now.
My school is near the park.
The letter was written by hand.

short: every, each, some, several of these
notes: Low in probes (0.18–0.38). Near misses are easy.
